label: Tessera · FAQ
description: Editable faq section for the Tessera design.

defaults.heading: Questions, answered
defaults.description: Can’t find what you need? Talk to us and we’ll get back to you within one business day.

items.question: What counts as a request?
items.answer: Any call to your Tessera API, including realtime messages, counted per month.

items.question: Can I switch plans?
items.answer: Yes. Upgrades apply immediately, and downgrades take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.

items.question: What happens if I exceed my limits?
items.answer: We notify you first. Pro and Team scale with usage-based overages, while Free pauses non-critical writes.

items.question: Do you offer discounts?
items.answer: Yes, for open source projects, students, and early-stage startups. Contact us and we will set it up.

items.question: Where is my data stored?
items.answer: In the region you choose when you create a project. The available regions are listed in the docs.

items.question: Can I self-host Tessera?
items.answer: Not today. You can export your data at any time in standard Postgres format.
